Remove worktrees and session artifacts

Stops the daemon, removes worktrees, removes session state and log files.

Aliases: `c`

```sh
woco cleanup [flags]
```

Modifies project state. Supports `--dry-run`.

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` |  | boolean | `false` | Show what would be cleaned up without removing |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
